entities.summary: Count Béla István Mária Széchenyi von Sárvár-Felsővidék was a Hungarian nobleman. He is best known for organizing an expedition to China, India and Singapore. He was accompanied by the linguist Gábor Bálint, the geologist Lajos Lóczy and geographer Gustav Kreitner.

entities.summary: Count Béla István Mária Széchenyi von Sárvár-Felsővidék was a Hungarian nobleman. He is best known for organizing an expedition to China, India and Singapore. He was accompanied by the linguist Gábor Bálint, the geologist Lajos Lóczy and geographer Gustav Kreitner.
